insert into projects (
  project_code, project_name, exec_unit, fund_source, unit_category,
  pi_code, start_date, end_date, extend_date_raw, close_date,
  approve_amount, received_amount, spent_amount, refund_amount_raw, manage_fee
) values (
  '{{$json.project_code}}',
  '{{$json.project_name}}',
  '{{$json.exec_unit}}',
  '{{$json.fund_source}}',
  '{{$json.unit_category}}',
  '{{$json.pi_code}}',
  {{$json.start_date ? `'${$json.start_date}'` : 'null'}},
  {{$json.end_date ? `'${$json.end_date}'` : 'null'}},
  {{$json.extend_date_raw ? "'" + $json.extend_date_raw.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'null'}},
  {{$json.close_date ? `'${$json.close_date}'` : 'null'}},
  {{$json.approve_amount ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.received_amount ?? 'null'}},
  {{$json.spent_amount ?? 'null'}},
  '{{$json.refund_amount_raw}}',
  {{$json.manage_fee ?? 'null'}}
)
on conflict (project_code) do update set
  project_name = excluded.project_name,
  exec_unit = excluded.exec_unit,
  fund_source = excluded.fund_source,
  unit_category = excluded.unit_category,
  pi_code = excluded.pi_code,
  start_date = excluded.start_date,
  end_date = excluded.end_date,
  extend_date_raw = excluded.extend_date_raw,
  close_date = excluded.close_date,
  approve_amount = excluded.approve_amount,
  received_amount = excluded.received_amount,
  spent_amount = excluded.spent_amount,
  refund_amount_raw = excluded.refund_amount_raw,
  manage_fee = excluded.manage_fee;

SELECT project_code, approve_amount, received_amount, 
       spent_amount, close_date, unit_category
FROM projects
